scenario.name: Discharge Delay Analysis
scenario.description: We analyse how specialist scheduling, diagnostics, and bed capacity causally influence discharge delays across the inpatient admission workflow. The model separates true clinical drivers from acuity-driven confounding.

executiveSummary.headline: Specialist assignment latency is confirmed as the dominant causal driver of discharge delay — statistically validated, not just correlated.
bullets: Recovered causal effect: 1.83 days via Double ML — the naive estimate ran 17.5% high due to confounding from Acuity / Comorbidity Index
Discovery precision 1.00, recall 0.89 across 20 bootstrap reruns (F1 0.94)
Recommended action: Guarantee specialist consult within 12 hours of request → ~$610K/yr expected savings
executiveSummary.recommendedAction: Guarantee specialist consult within 12 hours of request

edgeStability.edge: Acuity / Comorbidity Index → Specialist Assignment Latency

cate.note: The causal effect of Specialist Assignment Latency is concentrated in the High Case Complexity segment, suggesting interventions targeted by case complexity profile would yield different returns.

recommendedActions.title: Guarantee specialist consult within 12 hours of request
recommendedActions.detail: Specialist assignment latency is the dominant causal driver. A 12-hour consult SLA on the top three services removes most of the avoidable wait.

recommendedActions.title: Add evening imaging slots for inpatients
recommendedActions.detail: Shifting 20% of inpatient imaging demand into an evening block cuts diagnostic turnaround on the critical path.

recommendedActions.title: Start discharge planning at admission for elective cases
recommendedActions.detail: Early discharge planning frees downstream beds sooner and reduces the queueing effect on new admissions.

methodology.detail: Bootstrapped PC algorithm · 20 subsamples × 2,400 rows · 60% edge-stability threshold
Double ML (Chernozhukov et al. 2018) · 5-fold cross-fitting · gradient-boosted nuisance models · sandwich SEs
Planted ground-truth coefficients · placebo-treatment refuter (expected ≈ 0) · 10-seed stability check · bootstrap CIs
